Theme

Clothes & getting dressed

take off verb

clothes

also undress, get undressed

classical

Traupman 118, 400

exuō, exuere, exuī, exūtum

verb, third conjugation

Other words

  • dētrahō, dētrahere — take off (clothes, shoes)

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Traupman 118

Examples

  • Hanc vestem exue.

    Take this garment off.composed

  • Puer, calceīs, pilleō, paenulā dētractīs, in lectum suum positus est

    The boy, his shoes, cap and coat taken off, was put into his own bedLibellus VI, Reditus: per Alpēs domum

  • calceōs exuere

    take off one’s shoescomposed

  • sē exuere

    to get undressedTraupman 400

  • vestīmenta exuere

    to take one’s clothes offTraupman 400

See also put on, get dressed, security check.
